summary: Log Hopper: a frog hops over a river of floating logs with 3 lives, scoring 100 for each crossing, with logs speeding up each time.

check_changes.quote: Holding the stick does not hop again.
check_changes.what: The check pressed left and then held left straight away, so the stick never let go and there was no new press. Added a one-frame release between the presses.
